description_en: Modifies the binding relationship of a landline AXN extension number
description_zh: 修改固话AXN分机号码绑定关系
kebab_example: aliyun dyplsapi update-axn-extension-bind-fixed-line --app-id FC100000168480000 --ts 20161114143116123 --order-id 1230000000 --subts 20161114143116 --sub-id GHX00000000000000000000000000 --tela '手机号：18200002371_固话：057100000036' --anucode 1,2,3 --anucodecalled 1,2 --t-anucode-connect 1,2 --expiration 60 --remark 19394 --extraaxx Callback=0 Callrecording=0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAxnExtensionBindFixedLine

parameters.help_en: The business timestamp. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS. The time is in UTC+8, in 24-hour format, accurate to milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 业务时间戳，格式：yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS，时间采用北京时间，24小时制，精确至毫秒
parameters.name: ts

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the message request
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en: The binding time. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmss. The time is in UTC+8, in 24-hour format
parameters.help_zh: 绑定时间，格式为yyyyMMddHHmmss。时间采用北京时间，24小时制
parameters.name: subts

parameters.help_en:
Phone number A of the landline AXN extension.

Phone number A can be a mobile phone number or a landline number. For landline numbers, include the area code. Do not add a hyphen between the area code and the number
parameters.help_zh:
固话AXN分机的A号码。

A号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符
parameters.name: tela

parameters.help_en:
The caller-side ringback tone code. This parameter is required for AXB services. The code must contain codes for 3 scenarios. Enter the codes in the order of "B->X, A->X, other numbers->X", separated by commas.

"1,2,3" indicates that the ringback tone code for B->X is 1, for A->X is 2, and for other numbers->X is 3
parameters.help_zh:
主叫侧放音编码，AXB业务时必须设置。必须包含3个场景的编码。按照“B->X,A->X,其他号码->X”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2,3”表示B->X放音编号为1，A->X放音编号为2，其他号码->X放音编号为3
parameters.name: anucode

parameters.help_en:
The callee-side ringback tone code played after the call is connected. The code must contain codes for 2 scenarios. Enter the codes in the order of "A as callee, B as callee", separated by commas.

"1,2" indicates that the ringback tone code when phone number A is the callee is 1, and the code when phone number B is the callee is 2
parameters.help_zh:
接通后被叫侧放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2”表示A号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为2
parameters.name: anucodecalled

parameters.help_en:
The caller-side ringback tone code played after the call is connected. The code must contain codes for 2 scenarios. Enter the codes in the order of "A as callee, B as callee", separated by commas.

"1,2" indicates that the caller-side ringback tone code when phone number A is the callee is 1, and the code when phone number B is the callee is 2
parameters.help_zh:
接通后主叫侧的放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2”表示A号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为2
parameters.name: t_anucode_connect

parameters.help_en:
The expiration time. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

0: never expires.

Other values: when you specify another value such as 60, the binding remains valid for 60 seconds after phone number X is assigned. After 60 seconds, the binding is automatically released
parameters.help_zh:
过期时间，单位：秒，取值：

0：永不过期。

其他数值：传其它数值时，比如60s，分配X号码成功的60秒内，绑定有效，超过60s后，自动解绑
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_en: The external business extension field. This parameter is returned in the call record receipt message. The value cannot exceed 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 外部业务扩展字段，通话记录回执消息中会回传此参数。不能超过100个字符长度
parameters.name: remark

fields.help_en:
The callback control. Phone number A calls through X, meaning A is the caller and X is the callee. Valid values:

0 (default): outbound calls are not allowed.

1: connects to the most recent phone number N.

2: calls back the fixed phone number TelB
fields.help_zh:
回拨控制。A通过X呼叫，即A主叫X。取值：

0（默认值）：不能外呼。

1：接续最近的N号码。

2：回拨固定号码TelB
fields.name: callback

fields.help_en:
The call recording control. Valid values:

0 (default): recording is disabled.

1: recording is enabled.

After the call recording feature is enabled, you can play and download voice files in the call records. Recording files are billed at 0.010 CNY per minute
fields.help_zh:
录音控制。取值：

0（默认值）：不录音。

1：录音。

开启通话录音功能后，可在呼叫记录中播放和下载语音文件。录音文件按通话分钟计费0.010元/分钟
fields.name: callrecording
